visibleProduct: ChatGPT, Codex mode; About says Powered by Codex & OWL
backendInternalSource: vscode (internal label; this was not an IDE-extension run)

permissions.source: inherited configuration already visible as full access; not changed for this study

projectTrust: The human clicked the native trust dialog for control, auto, resources, always and scoped; automation did not confirm any security prompt.
globalHooksTrust: Earlier CLI dialog outcome uncertain; no hook-trust change made during this desktop group.
implicitInvocationObservation: No override added. Automatic selection observed in all five naming-review trials; global configuration was not independently enumerated.
restart: No app/backend restart; new desktop chat for every trial. Initial exports preceded loading the respective project; lifecycle reference regenerated before its fresh chat.

usage.notes: Totals reported by the 25 completed desktop conversations; cached input and reasoning output are subsets, not extra tokens. No API-key benchmark or credit purchase.

method: All prompts and native skill selections entered through visible desktop UI using Computer Use. First picker selection used a mouse click; later ones used Enter on the visible native candidate. Backend transcript reads were read-only evidence collection, not substitute inference.
uiIsolation: A second application window was opened after user navigation interrupted setup; it was closed after the lifecycle observation. No rejected input was submitted as an extra trial.
sanitization: User-profile and fixture-root paths replaced. Full source rollouts, personal memory, unrelated tool outputs, reasoning and uncropped UI remain local. Native body-injection blocks and relevant tool output retained. Cropped screenshots omit the personal sidebar.
